is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated CRISPR/Cas9 genome-edited Anopheles gambiae mosquitoes (Kisumu strain).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper functionally characterizes the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) target-site mutation.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No field-collected mosquito populations were genotyped or reported with extractable allele/genotype frequencies.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted exclusively on laboratory-maintained and genetically modified lines (Kisumu strain and its derivatives). No field sampling in Africa was conducted.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study generating novel CRISPR-edited mosquito lines and bioassay data.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection sites exist in this study.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study generated novel CRISPR/Cas9 edited laboratory mosquito lines.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files are not needed because the paper is ineligible due to lack of field populations.

assessment.summary: This study uses CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing to functionally validate the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) resistance marker in an insecticide-susceptible Anopheles gambiae laboratory strain (Kisumu). Because the research was conducted entirely using laboratory strains and contains no African field population sampling or genotype data, it is ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: Study evaluated laboratory strains/CRISPR-edited lines only (no African field populations).
Does not report extractable genotype frequency or count data for wild African field populations.
